reads.stopped_at: Search becomes available as soon as the first folder finishes indexing. That gives you a clear point to check whether your first available search is ready to use.
reads.what_it_sells: Portway is software that indexes files from a shared drive so my team can search them from one workspace.
reads.relevance_feedback: The profile establishes that I am a new account administrator who has signed up but has not connected a drive, so the request to connect my first drive directly matches my current setup stage. The email additionally assumes that I have a shared drive containing files I want searchable; that is plausible but not established, and the drive provider, permissions, security requirements, and setup effort remain unknown.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I have signed up for Portway.
Profile-supported: I have not yet connected a drive.
Email-only: I have a shared drive containing files that should be searchable.
Email-only: I am ready and authorized to grant Portway access to that drive.
Email-only: background indexing and searching partially indexed content are useful to me now.
reads.problem_now: Connecting a first drive is the documented next setup step for this account, but the profile does not establish an urgent need for file search. On a Tuesday morning with four hundred unread emails and a meeting in three minutes, this is relevant but not urgent enough to begin an access-granting setup without knowing its effort and permissions.
reads.biggest_doubt: I do not know which drive services are supported, what access Portway will request, or how long the connection step takes, so I would not start it immediately before a meeting.
reads.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me which drive services are supported, what permissions the connection requires, and approximately how long setup takes.
fixes: Rewrite "Once connected, Portway indexes the drive in the background. You do not need to wait for the entire drive to finish indexing before trying search." to include the requested access level and a realistic setup-time estimate.
Cut "That gives you a clear point to check whether your first available search is ready to use." because it repeats the preceding sentence without helping me decide whether to connect.

Rewrite "Open the connection page to connect your first drive and begin background indexing." as "Connect [supported drive names] in about [time]; before approving, you’ll see the exact permissions Portway requests."
